Name: Galaxy Scythe
Author: iamerrorz
Description:
Galaxy Scythe 1.3.2 is here!

Galaxy Scythe adds an endgame upgrade for the Iridium Scythe.

Bring your [b]Iridium Scythe[/b] to Clint and upgrade it using [b]2 Galaxy Souls[/b] and [b]2,000,000g[/b] to obtain the [b]Galaxy Scythe[/b].
The Galaxy Scythe can store seeds and fertilizer directly inside the tool. When harvesting crops, it can automatically plant loaded seeds and apply fertilizer where needed.

Features
[list]
[*]Upgrade the Iridium Scythe into the Galaxy Scythe.[/*]
[*]Requires 2 Galaxy Souls.[/*]
[*]Stores seeds inside the scythe.[/*]
[*]Stores fertilizer inside the scythe.[/*]
[*]Automatically plants loaded seeds after harvesting.[/*]
[*]Can also plant loaded seeds on empty tilled soil.[/*]
[*]Allows you to switch crops freely by default.[/*]
[*]Includes an optional [b]Require same seed[/b] setting to only replant the crop that was just harvested.[/*]
[*]When [b]Require same seed[/b] is enabled, wrong seeds are not planted or consumed.[/*]
[*]Does not waste seeds on regrowing crops.[/*]
[*]Automatically applies fertilizer when appropriate.[/*]
[*]Preserves existing fertilizer instead of unnecessarily replacing it.[/*]
[*]Respects normal season and location planting restrictions.[/*]
[*]Retains normal Iridium Scythe harvesting behavior.[/*]
[*]Includes an optional [b]Verbose messages[/b] setting for planting and loading feedback.[/*]
[/list]How it works
Load seeds and fertilizer into the Galaxy Scythe.
When you harvest a mature crop:
[list=1]
[*]The crop is harvested normally.[/*]
[*]If planting is enabled, the scythe checks the loaded seed.[/*]
[*]With [b]Require same seed[/b] disabled, any valid loaded seed can be planted.[/*]
[*]With [b]Require same seed[/b] enabled, the loaded seed must match the crop that was just harvested.[/*]
[*]One seed is consumed only if planting succeeds.[/*]
[*]If the soil needs fertilizer and compatible fertilizer is stored, one fertilizer is consumed and applied.[/*]
[/list]Regrowing crops such as blueberries remain planted and do not consume another seed.
Season and location restrictions still apply, so invalid seeds will not be planted.
Obtaining the Galaxy Scythe
Upgrade your Iridium Scythe at Clint's Blacksmith.
Required:
[list]
[*]Iridium Scythe[/*]
[*]2 Galaxy Souls[/*]
[*]2,000,000g[/*]
[/list]The upgrade uses Clint's normal two-day tool upgrade timer.

Loading the Tool
In your inventory, pick up seeds or fertilizer and [b]right-click the Galaxy Scythe[/b] to load them.
Right-click the Galaxy Scythe with an empty cursor to unload stored items. Seeds are unloaded first, then fertilizer.
The seed and fertilizer slots can be used independently.

Installation
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download Galaxy Scythe.[/*]
[*]Extract the
[code]Galaxy Scythe[/code]folder into:[/*]
[/list][code]Stardew Valley\Mods\[/code][list=1]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]The folder should look approximately like:
[code]Stardew Valley/
└── Mods/
    └── Galaxy Scythe/
        ├── GalaxyScythe.dll
        ├── manifest.json
        └── assets/[/code]
Configuration
The mod includes configuration options for:
[list]
[*][b]Require same seed[/b] — Off by default. When enabled, the scythe will only replant the same crop that was harvested.[/*]
[*][b]Enable planting[/b] — On by default.[/*]
[*][b]Enable fertilizing[/b] — On by default.[/*]
[*][b]Verbose messages[/b] — Off by default. Enable this to show loaded-item counts, planting notices, wrong-season messages, and other informational feedback.[/*]
[/list]With [b]Require same seed[/b] disabled, you can harvest one crop and replace it with a different valid loaded seed.

For example, harvesting cauliflower with Parsnip Seeds loaded will plant parsnips if the current season and location allow it.
With [b]Require same seed[/b] enabled, harvesting cauliflower with Parsnip Seeds loaded will leave the tile unplanted and will not consume the Parsnip Seeds.

If you have [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] installed, these settings can be changed through:
[b]Mod Options → Galaxy Scythe[/b]

Without Generic Mod Config Menu, they can be edited in
[code]config.json[/code]
Compatibility
Galaxy Scythe is designed for Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI.
Support for crops and fertilizer added by other mods depends on whether they use Stardew Valley's standard crop and item data.
Current status
Version [b]1.3.2[/b] includes fixes to seed matching and planting behavior.

Please report any bugs involving:
[list]
[*]Multiplayer[/*]
[*]Modded crops[/*]
[*]Modded fertilizers[/*]
[*]Special crop types[/*]
[*]Tool storage[/*]
[*]Clint's upgrade process[/*]
[*]Require same seed behavior[/*]
[*]Season or location planting checks[/*]
[/list]When reporting a problem, please include your SMAPI log, the steps needed to reproduce it, what seeds and fertilizer were loaded, and your Galaxy Scythe settings.
